messages:
Mina Support: Heads up — late-stage RFP from GlobaBank. They want contract language for 99.99% uptime + 50ms p95 in region us-east-1. Customer success flagged as high priority.
Jon Sales: +1, they're asking for SLA and a named support contact (P1 on-call). They want this in proposal next week.
Sara PM: Do we have precedent for 99.99% in hosted? I think Dedicated is what we've offered historically.
Alex SRE: We don't have a formal 99.99% SLA for hosted. Our current hosted SLO is 99.95% across regions. 99.99% requires redundancy + reserved capacity and verified cross-region failover. :thinking_face:
Liam Eng: Quick note: p95 50ms for text generation depends on model + seq length. For small embedding/encoders we can hit 50ms, but for 8k tokens on Llama2-family it's unrealistic without smaller model variants or autoscale guarantees.
Mina Support: The customer expects the API to behave like an enterprise endpoint — predictable latency + 24/7 phone support. Sales says they'll pay for dedicated.
Jon Sales: They're open to Dedicated capacity if we can quote a monthly commitment. We need a clear intake -> product backlog workflow so legal and sales can commit.
Sara PM: Proposal: intake form -> quick triage (prod vs infra) -> cost/feasibility + product acceptance criteria -> PO signoff -> commit ticket. Can someone sketch minimum launch criteria for an SLA offering?
Alex SRE: Minimal technical criteria from SRE side:
```
- Dedicated GPU pools for the customer's models
- Cross-region active-passive failover tested in last 30 days
- Autoscaling headroom reserved for p95 latency & throughput
- SLO monitoring, SLO export to customer dashboard and audit logs
```
Liam Eng: Product acceptance criteria (suggested):
```
- Documented latency SLOs per model class (embedding, small-gen, large-gen)
- Quantization/backoff plan for heavy tails
- Canary plan + rollback policy
- SLA page + incident playbook + named POC for 24/7 support
```
Sara PM: Great, that helps. Mina, can you capture customer expectations into intake fields: committed throughput, peak QPS, models they expect to use, retention/PD, and legal timeline?
Mina Support: Yup — captured. Added notes to the customer ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/GB-4213
triage-bot: Ticket GB-4213 assigned to #product. Priority: high. ETA for triage doc: 48h.
Jon Sales: Sales needs a one-pager for legal this week. Can product confirm if we can offer Dedicated + 24/7 P1 on-call as a purchased add-on?
Alex SRE: We can offer Dedicated + paid on-call coverage, but it requires a runbook and cost model. Ops needs 2 weeks to validate failover and baseline tests for a new pool.
Liam Eng: Dev constraints: If we promise 50ms p95, we must limit model family (50–100M parameter-ish) or invest in optimized kernels + caching. Recommend we negotiate latency per workload, not blanket 50ms.
Sara PM: Action items: 1) Product to draft SLA feature PRD (owner: Sara) 2) SRE to list technical gating checklist (owner: Alex) 3) Sales to provide committed usage & billing constraints (owner: Jon) 4) Support to collect runbook requirements (owner: Mina). Add these to the intake ticket.
Mina Support: I'll update GB-4213 with the checklist and attach the customer's RFP.
Jon Sales: If product can't meet blanket 50ms, we should offer tiers: "Gold": Dedicated + guaranteed latency for approved models; "Silver": Best-effort hosted with credits; include price delta.
Sara PM: Agreed. We'll propose tiered SLA offering in the PRD. Need estimates for cost delta from Eng/SRE to include in proposal.
Alex SRE: Rough estimate: reserving a Dedicated pool for 99.99% across us-east-1 + failover to us-west-2 -> ~1.8–2.4x infra cost depending on model size. Will refine with capacity numbers.
Liam Eng: I'll itemize engineering work (supporting named on-call, SLA exporter, per-customer dashboards). Preliminary estimate: 3 sprint-ish to get basic telemetry + rollout plumbing.
Sara PM: Timeline check — Sales needs a legal-ready statement by EOD Friday. Can we commit to a draft SLA by Thursday EOD for review?
Mina Support: I'll push GB-4213 notes today.
Alex SRE: SRE can deliver technical checklist by Wed COB.
Liam Eng: Engineering ETA for a costed scope doc: next Tuesday.
triage-bot: Created product backlog ticket PROD-8921 (SLA offering: Dedicated enterprise tier). Linked: https://redwood.internal/jira/PROD-8921
Sara PM: Cool — I'll produce the PRD draft and upload to the ticket. Please add comments directly to PROD-8921.
Jon Sales: Thanks. I'll brief the legal team that we're drafting a tiered SLA; won't promise 50ms across the board.
Mina Support: Customer message template drafted for delay/negotiation.
Sara PM: Closing loop here — next sync Tue 10am with SRE, Eng, Sales. If anything changes ping the thread. :thumbsup:
Alex SRE: :thumbsup:
Liam Eng: :eyes: looking at PROD-8921 after this.
Jon Sales: :rocket:
Mina Support: Thanks team.
